iconicAnchor.label: Decorated parchment manuscript folio
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The folio preserves the relationship among ruled text, decorated initial, miniature, margin, parchment, and reflective metal that defines the page as a crafted system.

sources.title: Manuscript leaf in the Getty collection
supports: A complete folio demonstrates how image, script, decorated initial, borders, and material surface share a single page hierarchy.

sources.title: Illuminated Manuscripts: Lesson One
supports: Illumination must be understood through manuscript materials, production, use, and page structure, not as interchangeable medieval fantasy decoration.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent lead with distinct support. The images jointly teach gold leaf, decorative border, dense, medieval while differing enough in subject, framing, or application to add useful range rather than repetition; both remain clear at card scale. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/illuminated-manuscript/reference-01.jpg. Distinct supporting role: Complementary support; adds a distinct subject, framing, or application without duplicating the lead.

culturalContext.note: Name the manuscript tradition, place, date, language, text function, and institution whenever known. Keep sacred and liturgical material in its documented context; do not mix Armenian, Islamic, Jewish, Byzantine, Insular, or Western European conventions into an invented universal medieval style.
